Celebrations: Classic Collection

Released October 8, 2021 · 25 cards

Celebrations: Classic Collection is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sword & Shield series, released in English on October 8, 2021. It has 25 cards. It includes 22 Pokémon, 3 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

12 illustrators worked on Celebrations: Classic Collection. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (5), Ken Sugimori (5), Kagemaru Himeno (3), Mitsuhiro Arita (3), Shizurow (2), Kazuo Yazawa (1), Kent Kanetsuna (1), Masahiko Ishii (1).
